cohort: 820 newborns born and hospitalized at Xiangya Hospital of Central South University from January 2020 to December 2020
finding: Larger gestational age, premature rupture of membranes ≥ 18 h, and maternal autoimmune diseases were independent risk factors for CRP ≥ 8 mg/L on admission, while cesarean delivery was an independent protective factor.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was an independent protective factor for CRP ≥ 8 mg/L on admission.
